add.describe.email: Forward your support address to your routing address; replies go out from your own domain.
add.describe.whatsapp: Sign in with Meta and connect your WhatsApp Business number.
add.describe.instagram: Connect your Instagram professional account: DMs, story replies and comments.
add.describe.telegram: Enter the bot token you got from BotFather.
add.describe.widget: Add a chat window to your website.
add.describe.test: A test channel for trying things out; it never reaches real customers.
delete.title: Disconnect "{{name}}"?

email.alias_hint: The local part of the address incoming mail is forwarded to (generated when empty).
email.from_hint: When empty, replies go out from the routing address.
email.domain_hint: Add the domain, create the DNS records below and verify.
email.name: Name
email.mode_forwarding_hint: Forward your support address to ClickFix's routing address.
email.mode_mailbox_hint: ClickFix reads your mailbox over IMAP and sends replies over SMTP.
email.from_hint_mailbox: Address replies are sent from; usually the mailbox's own address.
email.app_password_hint: For Gmail, Outlook and Yandex use an app password instead of the account password.
email.sync_days_hint: How many days of mail to import on first connect (1-365, default 3).
email.move_folder_hint: Optional; imported messages are moved to this folder.
email.secret_keep: Leave empty to keep the stored password.
email.test_failed: Could not connect. Check the server details and password.
email.test_needs_password: Re-enter the stored passwords to run the test.
empty.title: No channels yet
empty.description: Start by connecting email, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram, Slack, Teams, SMS, phone, the API or the web widget.
health.detail.send_failures: Many sends failed in the last 24 hours.
oauth.instagram_hint: You will be sent to Instagram; after granting access you come back here.
oauth.messenger_hint: You will be sent to Facebook; then you pick the page to connect.
oauth.failed: The connection could not be completed. The sign-in may have been cancelled or expired; try again.
oauth.no_pages: This account manages no Facebook page.
settings.title: Channel settings
settings.ai_hint: Let the AI agent answer this channel's conversations first.
settings.greeting_placeholder: Hi! We got your message and will get back to you shortly.
settings.webhook_hint: The API path the provider posts messages to (for reference; set up automatically when connecting).
telegram.hint: Create a bot with @BotFather on Telegram and paste its token; the webhook is set up automatically.
templates.title: WhatsApp templates
templates.hint: Starting a conversation outside the 24 hour window needs a template approved by Meta.
templates.name: Template name
templates.submitted: Template submitted to Meta for approval.
toast.check_failed: The provider rejected the connection; reconnect.
whatsapp.signup_hint: Pick your business account and number in the Meta window. You can connect several numbers.
whatsapp.signup_failed: The WhatsApp connection could not be completed.
add.describe.slack: Install ClickFix in your Slack workspace and route Slack Connect channels to the inbox.
add.describe.teams: Connect your own Azure bot registration; Teams messages arrive in the inbox.
add.describe.google_chat: Connect your own Google Chat app (Google Cloud project + service account); direct messages and the rooms you pick arrive in the inbox.
add.describe.sms: Send and receive SMS through your own Netgsm, İleti Merkezi or Twilio account.
add.describe.voice: Log calls of your Twilio number or Netgsm switchboard in conversations.
add.describe.api: Bring any system in with signed HTTP: you post messages, we post replies to your URL.
oauth.slack_hint: You will be sent to Slack to approve the install; then you pick the channels to route.
setup.generated_hint: Generated in your browser. You will see it once more after saving; it cannot be shown later.
setup.provider_hint.sms.netgsm: SMS sending, delivery reports and inbound SMS with your Netgsm account.
setup.provider_hint.sms.iletimerkezi: Sending with your İleti Merkezi API key; delivery reports come to the webhook below.
setup.provider_hint.sms.twilio: Sending and receiving with your Twilio number; callbacks are signed with the Auth Token.
setup.provider_hint.voice.twilio: Calls of your Twilio number with signed status callbacks and recordings.
setup.provider_hint.voice.netgsm: Netsantral call events, recordings and per-agent webphone.
setup.commercial_hint: Every SMS from this channel is checked against İYS consent (MESAJ / ONAY) before sending. Fill in the İYS fields below.
setup.show_once: Secrets are stored encrypted and never shown again. Generate a new one in the channel settings if you lose it.
setup.webhook_hint.sms.netgsm: Paste into the Interactive SMS forwarding URL setting for inbound SMS.
setup.webhook_hint.sms.iletimerkezi: Paste into İleti Merkezi → Settings → Webhook (delivery reports). The token in the URL authenticates the call.
setup.webhook_hint.sms.twilio: Paste into Twilio → Phone Numbers → your number → Messaging → "A message comes in" (HTTP POST).
setup.webhook_hint.voice.twilio: Paste into Twilio → Phone Numbers → your number → Voice → "A call comes in" and "Call status changes" (HTTP POST).
setup.webhook_hint.voice.netgsm: Paste into the Netgsm switchboard CDR / webhook setting. The token in the URL authenticates the call.
setup.webhook_hint.teams: Paste into Azure Portal → your Azure Bot → Configuration → Messaging endpoint.
setup.webhook_hint.google_chat: Paste into Google Cloud → APIs & Services → Google Chat API → Configuration → Connection settings → HTTP endpoint URL, with Authentication Audience "Project Number". Then pick the rooms in the channel settings.
setup.webhook_hint.api: POST signed APIChannelMessage JSON here. Replies are posted to your webhook URL with the same signature.
setup.api_signature: Headers: X-ClickFix-Timestamp (Unix seconds) and X-ClickFix-Signature = sha256=hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp + "." + body)).
setup.connected: Channel connected. Finish the setup on the provider side.
setup.token_hidden: The token in this URL is hidden. Generate a new webhook token above to get a complete URL again.
setup.file_hint: The key file you downloaded from Google Cloud (.json). It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
setup.file_too_large: This file is too large to be a key file.
slack.channels_hint: Only messages in the selected channels reach the inbox. Invite the bot first with /invite @ClickFix.
slack.list_failed: The channel list could not be loaded (the install may lack the channels:read permission). You can still add channel IDs below.
slack.none: The bot is in no channel yet. Invite it with /invite @ClickFix and refresh.
slack.empty_warning: No channel selected: no Slack messages are received.
google_chat.spaces_hint: Direct messages with the app always arrive. Messages in rooms (where people @mention the app) arrive only from the rooms selected here.
google_chat.list_failed: The room list could not be loaded (check the service account key and that the Chat API is enabled). You can still add space IDs below.
google_chat.none: The app is in no room yet. Add it to a space in Google Chat and refresh.
google_chat.empty_warning: No room selected: only direct messages are received.
calls.title: Call log
calls.empty_hint: Calls appear here once the provider sends its first event.
